thread:
Maya (EngOps): quick follow-up from today's all-hands infra update — can we get a short status on additional GPU supply for eu-west and APAC? also need clarity on the autoscaler burst policy (when it uses spot vs reserved) and our plan for "launch zones" vs region-level rollouts.

Andre (Infra): short answers first:
- eu-west A100s: procurement moved to next-week shipment; we're expecting arrival and onboarding by Wed  (still pending final network tests).
- APAC (singapore): vendor ETA is ~3 weeks; working on temporary soft-capacity via spot pools.
- autoscaler burst: default policy uses reserved capacity, then spot pools, then cross-region fallback. burst window is 60s by default; config is per-cluster.

Maya (EngOps): can you paste the snippet of the autoscaler config you referenced? that will help teams validate their route-level SLOs.

Andre (Infra): sure — minimal example we shipped for canaries:
```
autoscaler:
  burst_window: 60s
  preferred_pools:
    - reserved
    - spot
  cross_region_fallback: true
  spot_preemption_threshold: 0.2
```
Notes: spot_preemption_threshold=0.2 means we won't use spot if expected preemptions >20% for the request profile.

Sam (Product): when do we flip cross-region fallback on for hosted users? worried about surprises for latency-sensitive customers.

Andre (Infra): plan is staged: internal canary today -> 10% hosted traffic next Tue -> 100% two weeks after if telemetry looks good. teams will get an email before each step. fallback is only enabled for non-latency-critical routes by default.

Priya (CEO): priority callout — enterprise customers with reserved capacity get explicit controls; we will not silently fallback their traffic across regions without opt-in or ops coordination. Andre, please confirm the opt-in flow.

Andre (Infra): confirmed. Dedicated/reserved customers will see a new toggle in Console under Capacity -> Resilience. Default is off. Turning it on generates an alert and a change ticket for us.

Lisa (Customer Success): hearing a few large customers ask if APAC acceleration is refundable if we miss SLA windows. what's legal saying?

Maya (EngOps): @Priya / @Andre also, what contingency for customers who need APAC earlier than the vendor ETA?

Andre (Infra): short answer: we have two paths:
1) Short-term: route traffic to eu-west edge with regional cache + model shard placement (adds ~50ms median to requests but keeps consistency).
2) Medium-term: spin up private nodes in partner colo (costly) — we only do this for high-priority enterprise customers under contract.

Priya (CEO): let's keep option 2 for escalations. ops/sales, please surface any customers who'll need that.

Sam (Product): question: what about model variants? can we auto-fallback to smaller quantized variants to reduce GPU pressure?

Andre (Infra): yes — Canary flow includes model-variant fallback: if GPU queue > 75% for >30s, route to quantized-8bit variant in same region (same API surface). We emit a rollout flag so product teams can detect degraded quality.

Lisa (Customer Success): thanks, that's helpful to share with customers. any ETA on the Console toggle Andre mentioned?

Andre (Infra): Console toggle is in QA; target release Friday EOD. we'll post release notes and a small video.

Maya (EngOps): great. can we get a one-line action list so I can follow up with the PMs and support docs?

Andre (Infra): action items:
- Andre: confirm eu-west onboarding steps and post runbook (due Thu)
- Andre: enable internal canary and share telemetry dashboard link (today)
- EngDocs (Maya): draft customer-facing note on fallback behaviors (due Fri)
- Sales/Ops: surface customers needing APAC private nodes by EOD Mon
- Platform: toggle UI release Friday, add audit logging
:thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Capacity change: new spot pool for eu-west added to canary group — id: sp-8443 — initiated by Andre (Infra).

Sam (Product): 👍 make sure docs include the exact latency numbers for the eu->apac proxy path so PMs can triage feature flags.

Andre (Infra): will do. shared dashboard: https://dashboards.internal.redwood/infra/capacity/eu-canary (internal only).

Maya (EngOps): perfect — thanks everyone. i'll synthesize and ping channels.

Lisa (Customer Success): appreciate it! I'll prep a short FAQ for accounts on Monday.

Priya (CEO): thanks team — this sounds like a pragmatic plan. keep execs posted if anything slips.

Andre (Infra): closing loop: i'll post the runbook and telemetry snapshot in #eng-runtime when the canary is live.

Maya (EngOps): thanks — thread resolved for now :)
